body.statement:
If the exhaustive extension property in Open-ended Question 1 holds and \(\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)
eq\varnothing\), then for every signed \(w\), the sharp aggregate endpoints in Theorem 4 equal \[L_w=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}w_j
u_j-\operatorname{MC}(s(w);d^-,d^+),\qquad U_w=\sum_{j\in\mathcal J}w_j
u_j+\operatorname{MC}(-s(w);d^-,d^+).\] Primal and dual optimizers recover an attaining fixed-effect potential and anticipation vector. Feasibility of \(\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)\) is equivalent to absence of a negative directed cycle in the augmented interval-tension digraph.
body.justification: The transshipment dual makes arbitrary policy-relevant ATT summaries sharp, auditable, and computationally scalable without assuming coordinatewise independence.
body.gap: Voronin2025 studies generic stochastic LP values and ChenKyngLiuPengProbstGutenbergSachdeva2022 solves general minimum-cost flow. No located DiD paper derives this node-balance dual from a coupled anticipation fiber; uncoupled cellwise optimization does not deliver its joint support values.
body.consumer: The Callaway--Sant'Anna aggregation step can obtain exact event-time or calendar-time sensitivity endpoints and a dual certificate from the same risk-set graph.
